descriptions.tamal: Marinated pork wrapped in corn dough and banana leaf, served with criolla sauce.
descriptions.salchipapa: Fried potatoes with sliced sausage, served with sauces of your choice.
descriptions.huancaina: Boiled potatoes and eggs covered in huancaína sauce, with an olive.
descriptions.causaLimena: Layers of potato seasoned with yellow chilli, filled with chicken, peas, avocado and mayonnaise.
descriptions.caldoGallina: Homemade hen broth with noodles, potato and boiled egg, seasoned with herbs and spices.
descriptions.caldoMote: Traditional broth with hominy corn, meat and boiled potatoes, seasoned with herbs.
descriptions.ceviche: Fresh fish marinated in lime with red onion and chilli, served with sweet potato and corn.
descriptions.lecheTigre: Creamy concentrate of classic ceviche made with fish marinated in lime, onion and coriander.
descriptions.causaAcevichada: Traditional causa limeña topped with fish marinated in ceviche sauce.
descriptions.arrozChaufa: Wok-fried rice with chicken, egg, spring onion and soy sauce. A timeless chifa classic.
descriptions.aeropuerto: A mix of chaufa rice and noodles wok-fried with chicken, egg and vegetables in soy sauce.
descriptions.mostrito: Chaufa rice combined with broaster chicken, served with fries.
descriptions.tallarinChifa: Noodles stir-fried over high heat, chifa style, with meat and vegetables in soy sauce.
descriptions.combinadoChifa: Chaufa rice and chifa noodles served together.
descriptions.lomoSaltado: Strips of beef stir-fried with tomato, onion and fries.
descriptions.chicharron: Pork fried until crisp, served with sweet potato and criolla sauce.
descriptions.combinadoCriollo: A mix of ceviche, chanfainita, noodles and toasted corn with huancaína sauce, served together.
descriptions.polloBroaster: Breaded chicken fried until golden, served with fries and salad. Sauces on request.
descriptions.polloPlancha: Grilled chicken served with fries and salad. Sauces on request.
descriptions.wantanes: Crispy wontons served with tamarind sauce.
